description: The repo-wide stale-instruction sweep is incomplete. Even after moving the source of truth to `plans/overview-data.js`, several surviving prompts still tell future agents to update `plans/overview.html` or its removed JSON block: `plans/overview-data.js:505`, `:518`, `:531`, `:658`; `plans/parallel-assignments.md:133`, `:445`; `plans/crews-integration.md:3`. That directly violates the planned “grep for stale `edit plans/overview.html` instructions” cleanup and will send future work back to the derived view.
